get.summary: Get Revenue, ADR, and Occupancy metrics for a location
get.description: Either address or both lat and lng must be provided as location input.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the property location. Accepted range is -90 to +90. Required if address is not provided.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the property location. Accepted range is -180 to +180. Required if address is not provided.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Full address of the property. Either address or both lat and lng must be provided.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code for the revenue estimates (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, INR, AUD).

parameters.name: bedroom_category
parameters.description: Number of bedrooms for the property. Use 0 for studio.

parameters.name: monthly
parameters.description: When set to true, the response includes a MonthlyBreakup object with month-by-month KPIs. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: X-API-Key
parameters.description: Your Revenue Estimator API key. This is different from the Customer API key.

400.description:
In one of the following conditions:

  1. Missing Location Parameters
    Condition: Both lat/lng AND address are missing
    
  2. Missing Currency
    Condition: currency parameter is blank
    
  3. Missing Bedroom Category
    Condition: bedroom_category parameter is blank
    
  4. Invalid Address
    Condition: Address provided cannot be geocoded

401.description:
Invalid API Key
  Condition: When X_API_KEY header is invalid or missing

500.description: Internal server error. Please reach out to support@pricelabs.co

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description:
A JSON string containing filter criteria to narrow comparable listings. Pass as a JSON string, not a JSON object. Supported keys:
- **pool** (0 or 1) — Filter by pool availability
- **hottub** (0 or 1) — Filter by hot tub availability
- **ratings** ({"gt": n, "lt": n}) — Filter by listing ratings range
- **review_count** ({"gt": n, "lt": n}) — Filter by review count range
- **bathroom** ({"gt": n, "lt": n}) — Filter by number of bathrooms range
- **max_guest** ({"gt": n, "lt": n}) — Filter by maximum guest capacity range

**Example value (pass as a JSON string, not a JSON object):**
```
'{"pool": 0, "hottub": 1, "ratings": {"gt": 2, "lt": 5}, "review_count": {"gt": 5}, "bathroom": {"gt": 2}, "max_guest": {"lt": 4}}'
```

RevenueEstimatorV1ResponseKpIsByBedroomC.description:
Monthly breakdown of KPIs (Revenue, ADR, Occupancy, and Listing Count)
for this bedroom category.
RevenueEstimatorV1ResponseKpIsByBedroomC.title: RevenueEstimatorV1ResponseKpIsByBedroomCategoryMonthlyBreakup

ADRAvg.description: Average Daily Rate (ADR) across all listings in this category.

ADR25Percentile.description: 25th percentile of ADR values for listings in this category.

ADR75Percentile.description: 75th percentile of ADR values for listings in this category.

Revenue.description: Total revenue generated by listings in this category.

AvgOccupancy.description: Average occupancy percentage for this bedroom category.

NoOfListings.description: Total number of listings in this bedroom category.

MonthlyBreakup.description:
Monthly breakdown of KPIs (Revenue, ADR, Occupancy, and Listing Count)
for this bedroom category.

KPIsByBedroomCategory.description:
Key Performance Indicators grouped by bedroom category.
Returns data for n-1, n, and n+1 bedroom categories, where n is the requested `bedroom_category`.

RevenueEstimatorV2ResponseKpIsByBedroomC.description: Monthly breakdown of all KPI metrics with percentile data.
RevenueEstimatorV2ResponseKpIsByBedroomC.title: RevenueEstimatorV2ResponseKpIsByBedroomCategoryMonthlyBreakup

RevenueMonthlyAvg.description: Average monthly revenue across all listings.

Revenue25PercentileSum.description: Sum of 25th percentile monthly revenue (lower range estimate).

Revenue50PercentileSum.description: Sum of 50th percentile monthly revenue (median estimate).

Revenue75PercentileSum.description: Sum of 75th percentile monthly revenue (upper range estimate).

MonthlyBreakup.description: Monthly breakdown of all KPI metrics with percentile data.

bedrooms_considered.description: List of bedroom categories whose data was aggregated. For categories >= 5 with insufficient listings, this may include +/-1 categories.

KPIsByBedroomCategory.description:
KPI metrics for the requested bedroom category.
Each key represents the bedroom count passed in the `bedroom_category` parameter.
For bedroom categories >= 5, if there are not enough listings, data from +/-1 bedroom categories is aggregated. The `bedrooms_considered` field shows which categories were used.
